idea-plugin.name: OpenCode UI
idea-plugin.description:
OpenCode UI - AI Coding Agent for JetBrains IDEs.

Integrates the IDE with the OpenCode 2.x background service:

  • Click the OpenCode icon (or Ctrl+\) to open a dedicated OpenCode panel on the right side hosting the OpenCode TUI — the code editor stays visible next to the agent ("file tree | code | agent" layout).
  • The TUI connects to the running OpenCode 2.x background service (reads service.json) — no separate server spawn, so no more "server dead" restarts.
  • Send files / selections to the agent with Ctrl+Alt+K.
  • Clickable @path links in the terminal.
  • Native multi-file diff viewer with Accept / Reject when a turn ends.
  • Status bar indicator + completion notification when the agent finishes.
  • Tool window actions: New Session, Stop (ESC), Review Diffs.
  • Per-project session tabs: sets the OpenCode v2 TUI tabs.scope=cwd at launch so tabs no longer leak between IDE windows (e.g. PyCharm <-> IntelliJ).
  • Settings (Settings > Tools > OpenCode): custom binary path, auto-connect, tab scope, and terminal scrollback (unlimited by default).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.6 - Rollback without git. Every OpenCode turn is now recorded in the IDE's built-in Local History (right-click a file → Local History → Show History): the plugin puts an OpenCode turn start label before the agent edits anything and an OpenCode turn finished label when the turn ends, so you can always revert a class/file to the state it had before the AI touched it — no VCS, no guesswork. The diff viewer's Accept no longer runs git add unless the project actually has a git repo.

2.0.5 - Fix the panel being replaced by "This view is not available until indexes are built" while the project indexes. The OpenCode tool window factory is now DumbAware, so the terminal stays available in dumb mode instead of being swapped for the placeholder.

2.0.4 - Fix the OpenCode panel appearing and then turning into an empty tool box on newer builds (PhpStorm 2026.2.x). createLocalShellWidget now appends a tab to the global Terminal tool window and, when focused, activates it; re-parenting the widget's component into the OpenCode panel let the Terminal window steal it back. The terminal's Content is now moved into the OpenCode tool window and created without stealing focus.

2.0.3 - No line limit. The terminal history was capped at the IDE default of 5000 lines; a new Terminal scrollback setting removes the cap (terminal.buffer.max.lines.count) so long agent output is never trimmed and can still be scrolled back. It is unbounded by default; untick Unlimited to impose a finite cap. The buffer only grows with real output and never pre-allocates, so no RAM is reserved up front.

2.0.2 - Fix UI jank during long output. The plugin used to wipe the whole terminal scrollback (clearHistory) every 2 s once the buffer crossed 5000 lines, which forced a full repaint and made the panel stutter exactly when the agent produced a lot of output. JediTerm already bounds the history buffer (auto-evicting old lines), so the manual trim was both redundant and the cause of the jank; it has been removed.

2.0.1 - Fix session tabs leaking between IDE windows. The OpenCode v2 TUI keeps its tab strip in the global cli.json client state, so opening the panel in two IDEs (e.g. PyCharm and IntelliJ) showed the same (overlapping) tabs. The plugin now launches the TUI through a small wrapper that sets OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT with tabs.scope=cwd, so tabs are kept per project. New setting: Tab scope (per project / global).

2.0.0 - Rewritten for the OpenCode 2.x background service (/api/* HTTP surface + Basic Auth, auto-reconnect). OpenCode TUI now lives in a docked side panel so you can read the code while the agent works.
